uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1809-3603-4113.description:
Cast Cloudshift by tapping Returned Pastcaller due to Cloudshift's convoke ability, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-5478-6495-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5478-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5478-6495-7084.notes:
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

339-677-728-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7356--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7356--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Displacer Kitten and Longshot trigger.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

3532-5078-5645-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1621-2350-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

6159-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Bloodstained Mire.
6159-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Bloodstained Mire.
When Bloodstained Mire enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Bloodstained Mire by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-1315-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-1315-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-1315-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

3967-4681-5170-6772.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-7110.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-3019-7110.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-7110.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

250-779-1479-6517-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-6517-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2099-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3372-4050-6006-6968.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-6968.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2558-4742-5687-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

277-1170-4124-5954-6751.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1322-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {4}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1322-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1737-2292-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1236-2018-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

3490-4733-5231-6242.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Legate Lanius triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat until no opponent controls a creature.
3490-4733-5231-6242.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponents control, using the Servo generated from the last iteration.

222-527-997-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2104-3277-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
2104-3277-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1887-3774-4554-5900.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2034-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-5490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrifiicing Pith Driller, adding {C}{C}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2050-3525-5387.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Buried in the Garden attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-5387.notablePrerequisites: Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
2050-3525-5387.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
The triggered ability from the Aura triggers, adding an additional {U}.
Activate the Aura attached to Arbor Elf by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may add other colors in step 3.

1278-2816-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
1278-2816-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat until you have two or less opponents remaining.

2351-3304.notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control at least one other creature with power one or greater.
2351-3304.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Greater Good by sacrificing another creature with power one or greater.
If the creature was a Tentacle, The Watcher triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power and then discard three cards.
For each card drawn this way, The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating that many 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Repeat.

224-1257-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
224-1257-2232.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

1409-1624-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Storvald.
1409-1624-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Storvald by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Storvald enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, choosing not to repair it and Storvald.
Resolve the Storvald trigger, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become one until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

228-3701-4336-4763.description:
Equip Skullclamp to Kobolds of Kher Keep for {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep dies.
Skullclamp triggers, drawing you 2 cards.
Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Repeat.

1987-2427-3941-4125.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
